text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day before the fall Tenno Sho, Air Groove's mother comes to visit us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove's mother is worried about whether her uptight daughter is enjoying herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's filled with relief after witnessing the bond that Air Groove and I have built.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After some brief quality time together, Air Groove sees her mother off.
